title: Inorder Traversal of Binary Tree in Python - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Inorder traversal visits nodes in Left, Root, Right order. Time complexity is O(N) since every node is visited once; auxiliary space is O(h) for the recursion stack, where h is the tree height.

title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal in Python - TutorialsPoint
snippet: An iterative approach uses an explicit stack: push left children until None, pop a node, record its value, then move to its right child.
